meta.name: The Dissident
meta.description: When Washington Post journalist Jamal Khashoggi disappears after entering Saudi Arabia’s consulate in Istanbul, his fiancée and dissidents around the world are left to piece together the clues to a brutal murder and expose a global cover up perpetrated by the very country he loved.
cast: Prince Mohammed bin Salman al Saud
meta.slogan: The untold story of the murder that shook the world.
